missionPremise: place/radius-search is shipped and non-functional: valid params hang until Cloud Run kills at 300s. Candidate cause from the write path (not a measurement): texasCountyFipsList() is all 254 Texas counties so (county_fips, prop_id) has zero selectivity; txgio_parcel was claimed to have no bbox index; the query selects geometry. Size-independence (50 ft hangs like 500 ft) is the predicted result of a full scan that never hits LIMIT. Hypothesis must be verified against the live catalog, not lib/db/src/__tests__/__fixtures__/schema.sql.template.
completionPredicate: GET /place/radius-search?lat=30.10592&lng=-97.32528&radiusFt=500 returns a correct body in a stated time against the live service, and radiusFt=50 does too. Code-done is the query change plus tests plus a local EXPLAIN comparison. Live probe is planner-owned after deploy. Shipped-and-slow is not done.

recommendation.reasoning: B alone flips the plan from Seq Scan over 16.4M rows to Index Scan on txgio_parcel_prop_idx (608 ms, 37 rows). A (btree west_lng,south_lat,east_lng,north_lat) uses only the leading column for four independent range predicates; west_lng <= -97.32 is weakly selective across Texas and is not needed once county_fips is selective. B is correct regardless of A. Implementing B as the existing store shape: resolve 1-2 counties from tx_county_boundary bbox overlap, then constrain county_fips plus tile_key covering cells (PK). Measured 15.7 ms for the hung params. No production index apply. A is leave_behind, not this card: a sibling-consistent bbox index would need a run record and a planned apply, and this EXPLAIN says it is not what produces the index scan.
